messages:
neha_procure: Vendor just increased lead time for PO# 2026-09-01 H100 tranche by 2 weeks. They propose splitting shipment to reduce single-hub risk (AMS/FRA).

sam_ops: FRA customs has been slow this month. Splitting sounds safer. Which pools would be affected?

neha_procure: Vendor suggests 50/50 split. AMS for urgent/backfill, FRA for bulk. AWBs: AMS 1ZAMS11111, FRA 1ZFRA22222 (tentative).

maria_logistics: Carrier bot flags FRA AWB 1ZFRA22222 - needs commercial invoice + PO ref. Upload to portal to start clearance.

carrier_bot: Notice: AWB 1ZFRA22222 - customs hold. Clearance window 48-72h after docs upload. Email customs@carrier.example for manual expedite.

raj_eng: If AMS covers warm spares for na-west2, pin routing to prefer AMS for latency-critical pools. FRA can be assigned to batch/long-tail. I'll prepare routing config.

sam_ops: RMA note: depot found 2 DOA units (RMA-3344). Options: depot repair (~9d) or ship AMS loaners overnight (~$5k extra). Thoughts?

neha_procure: Asked vendor for written loaner offer and freight credit. If loaners possible, accept and avoid repair backlog.

maria_logistics: Uploaded docs at 2026-09-05T10:12Z. Carrier updated FRA status to "processing".

carrier_bot: Update: FRA AWB 1ZFRA22222 - docs received. Clearance ETA 36h.

neha_procure: Vendor confirmed 2 loaner H100s from AMS for 7 days, AWB 1ZAMSLOAN001, 30% freight credit on overnight. Drafting PO amendment.

raj_eng: Great. I'll deploy routing change and add a canary to monitor p95. Ping here when loaners checked into inventory.

sam_ops: I'll pause depot repair until loaners arrive. Thanks everyone.
